page_shape.entry: URL is the apply page itself; description on top, form below (no Apply-to-reveal step).
page_shape.form: one <form> (no id/action; JS submit). Top: 'Autofill from resume — Drag & drop or upload to autofill your application. Upload file' (input[type=file] accept=.pdf multiple). Then fields, custom questions, Resume dropzone, 'Apply' submit.
page_shape.headings: none (labels are plain text with a zero-width-space placeholder line)

control_families.text: input[type=text] name=firstName|lastName|linkedinUrl|phoneNumber; input[type=email] name=email; id ':rN:' (unstable). Required = native required attr; visible label text ends with ' *'.
control_families.custom_text: input[type=text] (or textarea) with name = UUID; required attr present; label is the preceding text node/element in the same column.
control_families.custom_radio: div[role=radiogroup] with input[type=radio] name=UUID, values 'Yes'/'No' (or 'yes'/'no'); label = text before the group; DOM required varies (dv-01 required=true, dv-03 false).
control_families.autofill_resume: input[type=file] accept=.pdf multiple + 'Upload file' button at top — parsing autofill, not the resume attachment itself. Raw binding: preceding_label of the 'Upload file' button = 'Autofill from resume Drag & drop or upload to autofill your application.'
control_families.resume: dropzone 'Drag and drop file or browse computer (PDF, 5 MB maximum)' with input[type=file] accept=.pdf multiple; label 'Resume (optional)' or 'Resume *'. Raw binding: preceding_label = 'Resume (optional)' or 'Resume *'.
